data.config.toml:
[info]
url = "http://mint:3338"
listen_host = "0.0.0.0"
listen_port = 3338
mnemonic = "file:/mint-secrets/mint-mnemonic"
enable_info_page = false
input_fee_ppk = 100
use_keyset_v2 = true

[info.quote_ttl]
mint_ttl = 600
melt_ttl = 120

[info.http_cache]
backend = "memory"
ttl = 60
tti = 60

[mint_info]
name = "Proofstorm CDK mint"
description = "Proofstorm regtest CDK mint"

[limits]
max_inputs = 1000
max_outputs = 1000

[payment_backend]
backend = "lnd"
unit = "sat"
min_mint = 1
max_mint = 500000
min_melt = 1
max_melt = 500000

[lnd]
address = "https://lightning:10009"
cert_file = "/lnd/tls.cert"
macaroon_file = "/lnd/data/chain/bitcoin/regtest/admin.macaroon"

[database]
engine = "postgres"

[database.postgres]
url = "env:CDK_MINTD_POSTGRES_URL"
tls_mode = "disable"
max_connections = 20
connection_timeout_seconds = 10

command: if stored_config=$(cdk-mintd config show 2>/dev/null); then desired_config=$(cat /config/config.toml); if test "$stored_config" != "$desired_config"; then echo 'stored CDK configuration differs from the immutable Proofstorm lock; refusing implicit config apply' >&2; exit 1; fi; cdk-mintd config apply --file /config/config.toml --validate-only; else cdk-mintd config validate --file /config/config.toml && cdk-mintd config init --new-mint --file /config/config.toml; fi
initContainers.name: initialize-config

command: trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; while :; do sleep 3600; done
containers.name: probe-chain-6123e71c

command: trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; while :; do sleep 3600; done
containers.name: probe-database-21c67c24

command: trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; while :; do sleep 3600; done
containers.name: probe-lightning-7d50d4b8

command: trap 'exit 0' TERM INT; while :; do sleep 3600; done
containers.name: probe-mint-2913daf3

stringData.mint-mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about
stringData.wallet-mnemonic: legal winner thank year wave sausage worth useful legal winner thank yellow
